items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: they gave us a full tune for Chick Bula

ctx.x: And they did everything. They tried to put us all in the union, you know, without the transfer. We'd see we was working on the transfer. Then they tried to, I don't know, they tried to do everything to get us in there. But they couldn't do it. They told us we still would have to be there six months before we could, they could hire us as a staff band. See, because they had some band there, the reason was for that. The band that they had there as their staff band was a band who they claimed took so long to learn…
Which hotel was that by the way? Is that one up on 126th Street? I remember musicians used to say that. Where were you? Yeah, that's where it was.
